summary: EPWK Holdings Ltd. (a Chinese foreign private issuer) reported on Form 6-K the results of its May 15, 2026 extraordinary general meeting, at which shareholders approved a multi-step capital restructuring: an authorized share capital increase from $1M to $40M (with 10B shares), followed by a par value reduction from $0.004 to $0.0001 per share, a 40-for-1 subdivision of unissued shares, cancellation of excess authorized shares to return to $1M authorized capital, and adoption of amended memorandum of association. The reduction creates a distributable reserve to eliminate accumulated losses. This is a balance-sheet restructuring, not a tender or return of capital. Watch for regulatory approvals under Cayman Companies Act (Revised) and potential future use of the reserve for dividends or further reorganization.
